name: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd
title: Apollo Micro Systems Ltd - 540879 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue up 81% to INR293 crore and order book INR1,432 crore, but management gave no numeric FY27 guidance, deferred large orders pending customer approvals, and working capital remains stretched at 359 days.

capex.quote: we are setting up all the test facilities, so that is something that will contribute to the overall holding periods

triggers.label: Working capital cycle 359 days in FY26
triggers.quote: reducing from 626 days in FY21 to 359 days in FY26

triggers.label: Organic growth 45-50% guidance missed (~36%)
triggers.quote: that couldn't happen because of the certain approvals, you know, which got pending actually from our customer

triggers.label: Order book INR1,432 crore at Q4
triggers.quote: Our order book as of 31st March stood at INR1,432 crores on a consolidated basis

triggers.label: Large orders expected in FY27, no numbers
triggers.quote: We'll continue to grow at similar pace.

guidance.quote: We'll continue to grow at similar pace.
